title: Polynomial split solver computation
statement: For all natural numbers $C$ and $e$, there is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet that, on every Boolean word $w$, halts after exactly $20\bigl((C+1+5e)2^e+46\bigr)(|w|+1)^{e+2}$ steps and outputs the following word: if there is an $i\le |w|$ with $i+C(i+1)^e=|w|$, take the least such $i$ and output the pairing of the prefix of $w$ of length $i$ with the remaining suffix; if there is no such $i$, output the empty word.
